description: Add a getVADStats() function to src/vad.js that returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech) tracked since the AdaptiveVAD was created

contract.raw_request: Add a getVADStats() function to src/vad.js that returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech) tracked since the AdaptiveVAD was created
contract.goal: Add a function getVADStats() to src/vad.js that returns an object containing speechCount and totalSpeechMs. This function will track the number of speech events detected and the cumulative milliseconds of detected speech since the AdaptiveVAD was created.
required_behavior: getVADStats() returns an object with speechCount (number of speech events detected) and totalSpeechMs (cumulative ms of detected speech)
The function is properly integrated into the VAD module
constraints: getVADStats() must not interfere with existing VAD functionality
The function must be properly exported from src/vad.js
The function must be included in the module's exports

acceptance_criteria.criterion: getVADStats() returns an object with exactly two properties: speechCount and totalSpeechMs
getVADStats() returns an object containing speechCount and totalSpeechMs with non-negative integer values
getVADStats() is properly exported from src/vad.js
getVADStats() is included in the module's exports

verification_plan: Check the function's return type and structure
Run automated tests to verify the returned values are valid
Inspect the module's exports to confirm the function is present
Verify the function's implementation includes the required properties
